name: H.A.R.D. part-time jobs (Lifeguard at 15+, Program Aide at 16+)
org: Hayward Area Recreation and Park District (H.A.R.D.)
what_you_do: Work part time for the Hayward park district. Lifeguards watch swimmers and teach learn-to-swim classes. Program Aides help run kids' activities like the mobile rock wall at different parks.
who_can_apply: Each job lists its own age. Lifeguard: at least 15. Program Aide (Mobile Recreation): 16 and up. Lead Lifeguard: at least 17. Many other district jobs are 18 and up. If you are under 18 you need a work permit from your school.
pay_detail: Lifeguard: $18.63 to $25.14 per hour. Program Aide: $17.74 to $23.94 per hour. Lead Lifeguard: $21.61 to $29.17 per hour.
duration: Part time. The Program Aide job is up to 12 hours a week on Saturdays and Sundays, year-round. Lifeguard shifts can include weekends, early mornings, evenings and holidays.
deadline_text: Jobs are posted on the district's job board as needed all year. The Lifeguard posting has no closing date. The Program Aide posting says it may close at any time.
how_to_apply: Go to the job openings link on the H.A.R.D. Employment page and apply online. You can also make a profile to be considered for future openings. Questions: Human Resources, (510) 881-6708.
notes: Lifeguards need a lifeguard card, a CPR card for lifeguards and a first aid card. They also need a TB test that comes back clear. Program Aides get first aid and CPR training in their first two weeks. Workers 18 and up are fingerprinted. Camp and swim teacher jobs for summer go up in spring. A 2026 summer flyer (not on the district's site) said 15 and a half and up, so check each job's age. Pool upkeep, nature, ropes course and gym coach jobs are for 18 and up.
